edits.before: title.text = victory and (run.ending=='true_victory' and '真结局 · 深渊已被封印' or "深渊已被封印") or defeat and "旅途在此中断" or "杀戮原塔2"
edits.after: title.text = victory and (run.ending=='two_act_complete' and '双幕挑战完成' or run.ending=='true_victory' and '真结局 · 深渊已被封印' or "深渊已被封印") or defeat and "旅途在此中断" or "杀戮原塔2"

result:GetChild("subtitle").text = victory and run.ending=='two_act_complete'
                and '第一幕与第二幕已完成。本局挑战到此结束。' or victory and run.ending=='true_victory'

edits.before: local finalFloor=victory and run.ending=='true_victory' and (self.map.terminalFloor or rules.floors) or rules.floors
edits.after: local finalFloor=Acts.isCompetition(run) and Acts.get(2).last or victory and run.ending=='true_victory' and (self.map.terminalFloor or rules.floors) or rules.floors
